cd /Users/migmac/Documents/GitHub/_ABM/paperclip && git add packages/deploy-cloudflare/src/worker/app.ts && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(deploy-cloudflare): auto-fallback to sidecar on CF-shim errors

Auto-bridged server handlers may call Node-only APIs at runtime that the CF
shim throws on (node:fs, child_process, command resolution). Previously each
such handler returned 500 to the user and required a per-route CF-native
shadow to fix.

This generalizes: when the auto-bridge handler throws an error matching a
known CF-shim message ("not available in CF Workers", "Command not found in
PATH", "Command is not executable"), we transparently retry the same request
against the sidecar. The sidecar runs the original handler with full host
capabilities and returns the result.

Triggered the change: POST /api/companies/:companyId/agent-hires →
materializeDefaultInstructionsBundleForNewAgent → fs.readFile → 500. This
fix turns it into a successful sidecar-served response without any per-route
shadow needed.

The request body is now buffered once at the top of the catch-all so it can
be replayed to the sidecar on fallback (handlers consume it via ctx.json /
ctx.text, which now read from the same buffer).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
)"
